    def set_extra_state(self, state):
        if state["operator"] != "unscaled_zero_content":
            raise ValueError("Unsupported content-dropout operator")
        if state["anchor"] != "earliest_nonpadding":
            raise ValueError("Unsupported content-dropout anchor")
        if float(state["content_dropout_p"]) != self.content_dropout_p:
            raise ValueError("Checkpoint content-dropout configuration mismatch")
        self.augmentation_seed = int(state["augmentation_seed"])
        self._augmentation_generator = None
        rng_state = state["augmentation_rng_state"]
        self._augmentation_rng_state = (
            rng_state.detach().cpu().clone() if rng_state is not None else None
        )
        self._augmentation_rng_device = state["augmentation_rng_device"]

    def _drop_item_content(self, sequence, item_vectors):
        # Evaluation and p=0 are exact no-ops, including augmentation RNG state.
        if not self.training or self.content_dropout_p == 0.0:
            return item_vectors
        device = item_vectors.device
        generator = self._augmentation_generator
        if generator is None:
            generator = torch.Generator(device=device)
            generator.manual_seed(self.augmentation_seed)
            if self._augmentation_rng_state is not None:
                if self._augmentation_rng_device != str(device):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "Augmentation continuation requires its original device"
                    )
                generator.set_state(self._augmentation_rng_state)
            self._augmentation_generator = generator
            self._augmentation_rng_state = None
        elif generator.device != device:
            raise RuntimeError("Move the model before starting augmentation")
        valid = sequence.ne(0)
        first_valid = valid & valid.long().cumsum(dim=1).eq(1)
        eligible = valid & ~first_valid
        draws = torch.rand(
            (*sequence.shape, 1), device=device, generator=generator
        )
        remove_content = eligible.unsqueeze(-1) & draws.lt(self.content_dropout_p)
        return item_vectors.masked_fill(remove_content, 0.0)
